subject: Draft MAP: signature runway and procurement schedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:12:00-04:00
Subject: Draft MAP: signature runway and procurement schedule

Hi Lina + team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP v0.1) and pulled out the key milestones so we have a single place to track owners and dates. Notes below and a couple of asks to keep momentum: 

Quick recap (from today's call):
- Business goal: Move Redwood inference into Acme's pilot by end of May/early June for Search Assistant POC.
- Key blockers: Internal procurement timing, SOW signoff, and legal review of data residency clause.

Proposed milestone highlights (see attached MAP v0.1):
- SOW draft & internal review — owner: Redwood (Ben) — target: 2027-05-10
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC2, retention) — owner: Acme security/procurement — target: 2027-05-12
- PO or signature — owner: Acme procurement/finance — requested target: 2027-05-24
- Kickoff for integration/infra prep — owner: Acme & Redwood — tentative: 2027-05-27

Asks: 
1) Can procurement confirm the realistic signature/PO deadline (we proposed 2027-05-24 to meet your desired pilot timeframe)?
2) Who should we loop into the SOW review (legal contact) and the security evidence requests?
3) Any constraints on payment terms or invoicing that would affect timing?

I'll follow up with an updated MAP once we have procurement's timeline and the SOW contact. Attaching: mutual_action_plan_v0.1.xlsx.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acme.com>

Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: signature runway and procurement schedule

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the MAP. A couple of quick notes from procurement: 

- Procurement note: typical internal procurement/finance cycle at Acme is ~10 business days once legal & finance have reviewed the SOW. With holidays this month we should plan ~2 weeks.
- To meet your proposed 2027-05-24 signature target we need SOW and security artifacts in hand by 2027-05-10 at the latest so legal can review and finance can process.
- Please send the SOW (Word preferred) and the security attestation PDF (SOC2 summary).

Procurement point of contact for this deal: Trevor Jones <procurement@acme.com> (copied on this thread). Trevor will coordinate PO timing and invoicing details.

Lina
Head of Product, Acme Corp

Date: 2027-05-03T10:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: signature runway and procurement schedule

Thanks Trevor & Lina — helpful context. I've updated the MAP to reflect tighter dates and explicit owners (attached v0.2). Key changes and proposal: 

Updated proposal (to give legal/finance the buffer you requested):
- SOW draft (Redwood) — owner: Ben Carter — target: 2027-05-10 (Ben: can you confirm you'll have the word SOW to send by EOD 5/10?)
- Security attestation (Redwood SOC2 summary + retention docs) — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — target: 2027-05-10
- Legal review & finance processing (Acme) — owner: Acme legal/finance/Trevor — target: 2027-05-20
- PO / signature (Acme) — owner: Acme procurement/finance — target: 2027-05-24 (preferred) OR latest 2027-05-27 to allow a 3-business-day buffer
- Kickoff/integration window — owner: joint — target: 2027-05-31

Proposed target close: I'd like to propose we book 2027-05-27 as the MAP "target close" (signature/PO) to give a small buffer beyond your 2-week cycle. If Acme can commit to 5/24 that's great; if not we can align on 5/27 but need SOW + security materials by 5/10.

Questions / next steps: 
- Ben: confirm SOW delivery by 5/10 and attach as Word doc.
- Trevor/Procurement: confirm whether a PO or DocuSign signature is preferred (we can provision a DocuSign envelope — link will be ready).
- Lina: confirm legal contact(s) to receive the SOW and security pack.

I've attached: mutual_action_plan_v0.2.xlsx and a draft SOW (redwood_sow_draft.docx). HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2027-03

Thanks — Marissa

--

Marissa — will do. Quick updates from my side: 

- I'll deliver the Word SOW to the thread by COB 2027-05-10. I'll flag any terms I expect legal to look at (data residency section, trial usage limits).
- I'll also include a short implementation milestone appendix so Acme's infra team can see the rough integration work and expected Redwood support hours (helps procurement size the PO).
- If Acme prefers DocuSign, we can prepare the envelope once Trevor confirms preferred signer and email for DocuSign. Otherwise we'll route a PO to Redwood's finance team.

Ben
